{{Infobox auto|Ptero Chicken Nugget}}

'''Chicken nuggets''' are small fried snacks shaped like dinosaurs. There are four, which differ only in name, texture and recipe layout: the '''Ptero''', '''Stego''', '''Brachio''' and '''Tricero chicken nugget'''. Each heals {{Hp|2}}, is eaten in 0.8 seconds and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/ptero_chicken_nugget.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
Each recipe makes 4 nuggets from [[Cooked Chicken|cooked chicken]] or [[seitan]], [[oil]] and [[flour]], arranged in a different L shape in the top-left of the grid. Obtaining oil unlocks all four, and crafting them returns the oil's glass bottle.
{{Recipes|Ptero Chicken Nugget}}
{{Recipes|Stego Chicken Nugget}}
{{Recipes|Brachio Chicken Nugget}}
{{Recipes|Tricero Chicken Nugget}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a nugget takes 0.8 seconds and heals {{Hp|2}}.

=== Trading ===
All four are among the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
